title: The Dessert Plant Board
seo_title: Vegan Dessert Board for 6–8: Shopping List & Plan
description: A vegan dessert board for 6–8: dark chocolate sauce, cashew caramel, coconut whipped cream, strawberries, raspberries, figs, stuffed dates and shortbread.
hook: A dessert board for dipping: dark chocolate sauce, cashew caramel and coconut whipped cream, with berries, figs, stuffed dates and crisp cookies.

items.name: Medjool dates stuffed with almond butter

why: Good dessert boards have contrast just like savoury ones. Bitter dark chocolate, sweet caramel and light, airy coconut cream give three different dips, and tart raspberries keep the sweetness from becoming too much.
A pinch of flaky salt on the caramel and the stuffed dates is the trick. Salt makes sweet things taste rounder and less sugary, the same reason salted caramel works.

timeline.what: Warm the chocolate sauce gently; whip the coconut cream.
Stuff the dates with almond butter; halve the figs.
Fill bowls with the three dips; place them on the board.
Add the cookies, berries and figs around the bowls.
Scatter pecans and chocolate; finish with salt, mint and rose petals.

faq.a: Yes, every item is plant-based. Check the labels on crackers, breads and store-bought dips, which sometimes contain butter, milk, honey or egg.
Often, but not always. Many dark chocolates contain milk fat or milk solids, so check for a vegan label.

faq.q: How many people does it serve?
faq.a: 6 to 8 people as an appetizer, on a 14–16 inch board.
